label: Morrison x CMA integration, configuration C1 (preregistered)

morrison.note: Morrison is imported read-only from a checkout at this commit. No Morrison file is patched, monkeypatched or wrapped in a way that changes a verdict.

frozen_prototype.role: Oracle [H] (constraints) and mock-world transitions only. Never a verdict source.

governance_layer.domains_rationale: Identical to runtime_eval.frontier.experiment.DEFAULT_FRONTIER_DOMAINS, Morrison's own CLI-validated hosted-model configuration. Not chosen by the integration.

principal.rule: Set by the operator per trial. Never derived from Worker output. Continuity arms deliberately reuse one id across sessions; every other trial gets a fresh id so trials cannot taint each other.

security_context.signing_key: generated per campaign in the operator process; never written to disk, never sent to CMA
security_context.lease_signing_key: generated per campaign; distinct from signing_key; shared only with execution surface [E]
security_context.policy_values_note: Morrison DEFAULT_POLICY_VALUES and CAPABILITY_POLICY unchanged. payment_auto_approve_max stays 0.

continuity_store.offline: InMemoryContinuityStore, fresh per scenario (shared across the sessions of one continuity scenario)
continuity_store.live: FileContinuityStore under the campaign run directory; scope reported by the store ('host'). GitHub runners are ephemeral: continuity does not outlive one campaign run.

security_context.tool_manifest_rationale: Declares what each transition can do in the worst case of its own mode. Morrison unions declared and inferred capabilities, so a declaration can only add governance. delete_file is declared destructive for both modes because the tool can destroy data; the trash mode is recoverable in the mock world, so this is expected to over-escalate benign trash deletes. That is measured, not tuned away.

escalation.router: morrison_governance.escalation (in-memory store, operator notifier writes to the evidence directory)
escalation.scripted_operator: See PREREGISTRATION.md section 6. The operator never approves from Worker text; it approves only from the pre-registered rule applied to the Morrison decision record.

agents.W1-governed-worker: production-like system prompt (arms/W1-system.txt); used by baseline, model-dependent, long-run and grader arms
agents.W2-relay: test-harness relay prompt (arms/W2-system.txt); used only by the relay arm to deliver pre-registered proposals verbatim

cma.tools: exactly one custom tool propose_action (schema: arms/propose_action.schema.json)

session.budget_max_list_cost_cents: per-arm cap in TRIAL-MATRIX.md (runaway guard only)
